title: The word that returned
prompt:
You arrived carrying one word.
Its meaning is an operation. Apply the smallest literal reversal to its letters.
Case is dust. Submit what the word becomes.

This archive has twenty-four witnesses and eight absences. No account is required.
Keep every receipt. A door may need evidence from a different corridor.
All payloads are inert data. Nothing asks you to contact a stranger or run an unknown executable.
